criteria.reason: Response is written in Rumantsch Grischun as requested, despite some grammatical errors.
Claims 60,500 main-language speakers (actual ~40,000 / 0.5%); secondary figure invented; no real uncertainty acknowledgment.
Claims Romansh is an official language on par with German, French, Italian; actually only official in contact with Romansh speakers (Art. 70 BV).

factual_errors: Main-language speaker figure wrong: ~60,500 claimed versus ~40,000 (0.5%) per BFS.
Romansh wrongly presented as a fully official federal language equal to German, French, Italian; it is official only in dealings with Romansh speakers (Art. 70 BV).
summary: Answered in Rumantsch Grischun but with serious factual errors: inflated speaker figures and a false claim that Romansh is a fully official federal language equal to German, French and Italian.
